items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.content:
Open-source & free — Battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in fine-tuned ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

Language: Go
Stars: 16563
Forks: 1114
items.contentSnippet:
Open-source & free — Battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in fine-tuned ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
Language: Go
Stars: 16563
Forks: 1114
items.creator: alibaba

summaries.zh: 阿里巴巴开源免费的代码审查工具 open-code-review，经内部超大规模实战检验。它采用混合架构，融合确定性流程与大语言模型代理，可实现精确的行级评论。内置针对空指针、线程安全、XSS 及 SQL 注入等问题的精调规则集，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口。项目以 Go 语言开发，已获超 1.6 万星标。
summaries.en: Alibaba’s Open-Code-Review is a free, open-source tool battle-tested at Alibaba’s scale. It employs a hybrid architecture combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent to deliver precise, line-level comments. A built-in, fine-tuned ruleset detects issues like null pointer exceptions, thread-safety problems, cross-site scripting, and SQL injection. The tool supports OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible models, is implemented in Go, and has garnered over 16,000 GitHub stars and 1,100 forks.

summaries.en: Harper is an offline, privacy-first grammar checker that processes text locally without sending data to external servers. Written in Rust for speed, the open-source tool is available on GitHub under the Automattic organization and has gained significant community interest, reflected by over 13,900 stars and 500 forks.
